thread:
Alicia: FYI vendor updated lead times for our H100 order. Original 6w -> now 10-12w. They propose a split: 22 units air (earlier) + 18 sea (later). Also want EU RMAs routed to their FRA depot.

Priya (Procurement): Any reason given for the slip?

hyperlogix-bot: Vendor note: "Delay due to SubFab-3 capacity constraints and export paperwork backlog. Propose split to cover urgent NA demand. Air tranche carries an expedite uplift of 12% and requires 20% deposit for the air booking. Insurance: GlobalCover (policy GC-24-HYP). RMA: FRA vendor depot for EU; NA RMAs to partner depot in CA."

Mike: 12% + 20% deposit is better than some quotes but still painful. The RMA endpoint change is risky for our warranty flow. We need ticketing access and SLA commitments before agreeing.

Leah Ops: If we accept split, we should earmark air tranche to Dedicated NA pool only. Also require serial manifest 72h pre-pick and HS codes on the manifest. Vendor once shipped without SKU mapping and it was a nightmare.

Priya (Procurement): Let's negotiate commercial terms: cap expedite at 10%, deposit 15% refundable if they miss air ETA by >5 days. Net payment for remainder 15 days after delivery.

Ryan (Logistics): I'll push for manifest, AWB 48h ahead, and insurance beneficiary set to Redwood Inference for transit claims. Also ask vendor to provide FRA depot EORI, contact, and a machine-readable ticketing endpoint (API) or at minimum a daily status CSV. Customs implications if returns land at vendor-operated depot must be explicit (DDP vs DDU).

Alicia: Ops, can you confirm we can reserve 22 units to Dedicated NA? We must not let them flow into burst.

Leah Ops: Tentatively yes but need a PO amendment to formalize allocation. Also require a pre-shipment remote audit (video walkthrough) 48-24h before pickup to validate serials.

hyperlogix-bot: Vendor response (parsed): "Can provide serial manifest 72h pre-ship, AWBs 48h pre-arrival, and GlobalCover policy details. Deposit 20% firm due to air carrier slot costs; expedite fee reducible to 11% for this account. FRA depot cannot be changed due to existing forwarder agreement. Offer refund clause: refund 75% of deposit if air tranche misses ETA by >7 days."

Mike: Fractions look okay but we must insist on SLA-backed credits. Propose: diagnosis TAT <=8 business days; per-unit downtime credit €400/day starting after day 10, capped at 50% of unit value. Photo evidence on delivery required for damage claims.

Priya (Procurement): I'll send a concise amendment with these points. Key asks:
- expedite <=11%
- deposit <=20% with 75% refund if delay >7d
- manifest CSV (serial, SKU, PO#, HS code) 72h pre-ship
- AWB 48h pre-arrival
- insurance policy number + beneficiary
- FRA depot contact + API or daily status CSV + depot EORI
- RMA TAT <=8 business days; downtime credit €400/day after day 10, cap 50% unit value
- option to pay an extra handling fee to route EU RMAs to our FRA repair partner (if vendor cannot change depot)

Ryan (Logistics): Carrier options I can push: LH Cargo or AeroSwift; LH cheaper but limited slots, AeroSwift faster. I'll also request incoterm confirmation (DDP preferred for air tranche).

Leah Ops: Also require clear repair scope (parts vs swap) and whether depot issues include firmware reflash. If it's vendor depot, we need API ticket ids and SLA-driven credits.

Alicia: Good. If vendor accepts manifest + API visibility + downtime credits we greenlight split and Priya will route PO amendment. If not, we hold and accept longer ETA.

hyperlogix-bot: Vendor acknowledged amendment request; promised internal review and counter by COB.

Priya (Procurement): I'll draft amendment and loop in legal for the credit language. If they push back hard I'll escalate to exec procurement.

Alicia: Thanks all. Keep updates here.

Mike: One more ops note 9D include an acceptance checklist at handoff: photos, serial scan, manifest sign-off by carrier rep.

Leah Ops: +1. Add remote pre-pick audit clause.

Ryan (Logistics): On it. Reaching out to vendor now.

Alicia: Tagging @procurement for visibility. Waiting on vendor counter (COB).
